'''Kaastini''' is a [[landlocked country]] in [[West Massir]]. It is bordered by [[Dahe]] to the north, [[Suenan]] to the southeast, and Vesozata to the east. It covers an area of {{convert|sp=us|	664,569|km2|abbr=off}}, making it the [[List of countries and dependencies by area | 51st-largest country]] in the world. With a population of 4.3 million, Kaastini is one of the world's [[List of countries and dependencies by population density|most sparsely populated sovereign states]]. The country constitutes a significant portion of the [[Kaastini Plateau]], and its natural environment is characterised by grassy [[steppe]], the [[Kozhika Mountains]] to the south and east, and the [[Hiemuekan Desert]] through the middle of the country. [[Suharimti]], the capital and [[List of cities in Kaastini|largest city]], is home to roughly a quarter of the country's population.

The territory of modern-day Kaastini has been ruled by various [[nomadic empire]]s, including the [[Mesti]], the [[Cutrans]], the [[Xhinj]], the [[Kurtan]], the [[Suadona]], and others. In 1050, [[Aluri Guian]] founded the [[Kaastini Empire]], which became the largest [[List of largest empires|contiguous land empire]] in history. His grandson [[Fiani Guian]] finished the conquest of [[Dahe]] and established the [[Kaauan dynasty]]. After the collapse of the Kaauan, the [[Kaauans]] retreated to Kaastini and resumed their earlier pattern of factional conflict, except during.

In the 13th century, [[Kallimethra in Kaastini|Kallimethra]] spread to Kaastini. The [[Dahlii dynasty]] absorbed the country in the 15th century. After the [[Dahlii Chaos]] in 1670, Kaastini declared independence and achieved actual independence from the [[Dahen Republic]] in 1674 as the Kaastini Confederation. Shortly thereafter, the country became a [[wikiepdia:satellite state|satellite state]] of the [[Dahen Republic]]. In 1695, the Republic of Kaastini was founded after it conducted its own peaceful [[Kaastini Revolution of 1694]]. This led to a [[wikipedia:multi-party system|multi-party system]], a new [[Constitution of Kaastini|constitution of 1698]], and a transition to a [[wikipedia:market economy|market economy]].

Approximately 10% of the population is [[wikipedia:nomad|nomad]]ic or semi-nomadic. [[Kallimethra]] is the majority religion (51.7%), with the [[Passanu]] being the second-largest group (40.6%). [[wikipedia:Irreligion|Irreligion]] is the third-largest religious identification (3.2%), concentrated among youth in the cities. The vast majority of citizens are ethnic Kaastini, with roughly 5% of the population being [[Dahe|Dahen]], and other ethnic minorities, who are especially concentrated in the western regions. Kaastini is a member of the [[Global Trade Union]], [[Democratic Action Council]].
